parsed.notes:
The final Skills section is treated literally as an unmarked candidate-skills list, not a company tech stack; consequently CUDA and Cloud Computing are required, and even anomalous technologies such as Juniper Networks M-Series and RIP are retained as unmapped.
Responsibilities-only technologies and techniques, including ONNX, Jetson, distillation, and LoRA, are excluded.
The research-to-production requirement explicitly combines serving, monitoring, and iteration, and is interpreted as MLOps.
Model optimization is left unmapped rather than assumed to mean inference optimization specifically.
Publications, generic open-source participation, manufacturing-domain knowledge, and soft skills are excluded. The optional 3D perception mention collapses into the required computer-vision criterion.
Alternative sets involving unmapped technologies cannot be represented using the prescribed unmapped-item schema; no mapped alternative group contains two eligible members.
